sections.title: Recommendations
sections.content:
We recommend that you move £20,000 from your Holloway cash account into your Holloway Stocks & Shares ISA. This step is intended to make use of available cash by contributing it to your existing ISA, in line with your moderate risk profile (4). No existing investments are being sold, and the transfer is purely from cash on deposit. The initial charge applicable to this ISA top-up is 0%.

Please note that platform charges may apply, which will need to be confirmed prior to proceeding further.
